cd /tmp/obench-cell-wdotrlk2/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_pk1451hs; python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
d=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy(); bad=0; ious=[]
for (i,r),(_,q) in zip(d.iterrows(),o.iterrows()):
    p=np.stack([list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))],1)
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[p],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m); bad+= n!=2
    cnt+=m
    assert r.xmin==p[:,0].min() and r.ymax==p[:,1].max()
    pq=np.stack([list(map(int,q.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,q.coords_y.split(',')))],1)
    m2=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m2,[pq],1)
    ious.append(((m&m2).sum()/(m|m2).sum(), q.type))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(0,255,0),1)
    if q.type=='rectangle': cv2.polylines(vis,[pq],True,(0,0,255),1)
print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'noncontig',bad, 'rows',len(d), (d.columns==o.columns).all())
print('poly iou',np.mean([a for a,t in ious if t=='polyline']),'rect iou',np.mean([a for a,t in ious if t=='rectangle']))
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2))
EOF
